Comments: Built bottom-up from 26 individual product lines (see Revenue Master) — unit volumes × ASPs by SKU, not top-down market-share assumptions. Reflects the FPGA-pilot-to-ASIC-volume transition from FY2027.

Segment-weighted: each revenue line carries its own gross margin (see Assumptions). Blended gross margin expands from 53% to 88% as the mix shifts toward high-margin silicon and software and as the 28nm mask amortises across volume.
Margin expansion is structural, not assumed — it follows the FPGA?ASIC cost transition (die cost falls ~16× at volume) and a rising software/licence attach rate.
